SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q3. Which one of the following soils is ideal for growing cotton?  
(A) Alluvial Soil  
(B) Red Soil  
(C) Black Soil  
(D) Laterite Soil

Answer / Solution:
Which one of the following soils is ideal for growing cotton? 
(C) Black Soil 
Reasoning: Black soil is also known as regur soil or black cotton soil because 
it is ideal for growing cotton.
